answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 17 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in willow, queued in harbor, and ripple publishes the wait time. A farm of 137 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3731 identities would post 3046 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
